pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Devadatto saṃghabhedāya parakkamati cakkabhedāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma Devadatto saṃghabhedāya parakkamissati cakkabhedāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.6: evaṃ vutte Kokāliko Kaṭamorakatissako Khaṇḍadeviyā putto Samuddadatto te bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.9: amhākañ ca Devadatto chandañ ca ruciñ ca ādāya voharati, jānāti no bhāsati, amhākaṃ p' etaṃ khamatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.10: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū Devadattassa saṃghabhedāya parakkamantassa anuvattakā bhavissanti vaggavādakā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.12: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.13: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū Devadattassa saṃghabhedāya parakkamantassa anuvattakā vaggavādakā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.16: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā Devadattassa saṃghabhedāya parakkamantassa anuvattakā bhavissanti vaggavādakā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.17: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.18: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.19.1: tass' eva kho pana bhikkhussa bhikkhū honti anuvattakā vaggavādakā eko vā dve vā tayo vā, te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.21: dhammavādī c' eso bhikkhu vinayavādī c' eso bhikkhu
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.22: amhākañ c' eso bhikkhu chandañ ca ruciñ ca ādāya voharati, jānāti no bhāsati, amhākaṃ p' etaṃ khamatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.23: te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.25: na c' eso bhikkhu dhammavādī na c' eso bhikkhu vinayavādī,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.27: samet' āyasmantānaṃ saṃghena, samaggo hi saṃgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.28: evañ ca te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vuccamānā tath' eva paggaṇheyyuṃ, te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.29: yāvatatiyañ ce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyyuṃ icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.6: yaṃdiṭṭhiko hoti yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko te pi taṃdiṭṭhikā honti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.9: eko vā dve vā tayo vā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.10: eko vā hoti dve vā tayo vā. te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.11: māyasmanto etaṃ bhikkhuṃ kiñci avacuttha, dhammavādī c' eso bhikkhu vinayavādī c' eso bhikkhu
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.12: amhākaṃ c' eso bhikkhu chandañ ca ruciñ ca ādāya voharati, jānāti no bhāsati, amhākaṃ p' etaṃ khamatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.16: aññehi bhikkhūhi ye passanti ye suṇanti, tehi vattabbā:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.18: na c' eso bhikkhu dhammavādī na c' eso bhikkhu vinayavādī,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.21: samaggo hi saṃgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.27: te bhikkhū saṃghamajjham pi ākaḍḍhitvā vattabbā:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.41: itthannāmo ca itthannāmo ca bhikkhū itthannāmassa bhikkhuno saṃghabhedāya parakkamantassa anuvattakā vaggavādakā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.43: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmañ ca itthannāmañ ca bhikkhū samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.48: saṃgho itthannāmañ ca itthannāmañ ca bhikkhū samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.49: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa ca itthannāmassa ca bhikkhūnaṃ samanubhāsanā tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.59: samanubhaṭṭhā saṃghena itthannāmo ca itthannāmo ca bhikkhū tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.65: saṃghādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjantānaṃ ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā paṭippassambhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:2.66: dve tayo ekato samanubhāsitabbā, taduttari na samanubhāsitabbā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:3.1.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajjanti, āpatti saṃghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:3.1.2: dhammakamme vematikā na paṭinissajjanti, āpatti saṃghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:3.1.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajjanti, āpatti saṃghādisesassa.
